prose.text:
# Deninger metaplectic--Steinberg descent

- **ID:** `deninger-metaplectic-steinberg-descent`
- **Stage:** 1-in-progress
- **Type:** CONJECTURE
- **Parent:** `deninger-prime-holonomy-groupoid`
- **Source:** `docs/Deninger program.md` · `deninger-rectangular-quaternionic-hodge`
- **Statement:** The missing arithmetic coefficient twist is the metaplectic lift of the
  positive-similitude prime holonomy, formed before passing from universal Steinberg
  \(K_2\)-descent to its quaternionic representation.

## Motivation

Two independently forced pieces of the Deninger construction have the same square-root shape:

1. the moving rectangular prime map has determinant and metric weight \(p\), so its centered
   action is \(p^{-1/2}A_p\);
2. arithmetic \(H^1\) must be odd in \(K_{\mathbb R}\), hence its Hodge operator is anti-linear
   and squares to \(-1\).

For \(\tau=ir\), the positive similitude
\[
  A_q=\begin{pmatrix}q&0\\0&1\end{pmatrix}
\]
sends \(\tau\) to \(q\tau\).  Centering gives
\[
  q^{-1/2}A_q
   =\begin{pmatrix}\sqrt q&0\\0&1/\sqrt q\end{pmatrix}\in SL_2(\mathbb R).
\]
Square-root lifts of symplectic transformations are metaplectic.  Universal central extensions
of the relevant rank-two linear groups are controlled by Steinberg symbols and \(K_2\).  This
suggests that the missing half-density/quaternionic twist and the missing Steinberg relation are
not separate repairs.

## Exact frontier

- `[PAPER-PROVED]` Moving rectangular holonomy has weight one, forced coefficient \(1/r\), and
  forced centered exponent \(1/2\).
- `[PAPER-PROVED]` Its complexified tangent plane has a positive anti-linear
  \(\star^2=-1\) operator, preserved by centered holonomy.
- `[LITERATURE]` Kucharczyk--Scholze ask for a correction of their rational-Witt space obtained by
  freely adjoining the Steinberg relation in cohomology.
- `[LITERATURE]` Deninger's 2025 finite-flat/\(h\)/\(qfh\) sheafification still returns
  \(W_{\mathrm{rat}}\); stronger descent is required.
- `[LITERATURE]` Metaplectic/Weil representations arise by lifting projective symplectic actions
  to central extensions.  Matsumoto-style universal extensions are presented through Steinberg
  symbols.
- `[LITERATURE]` Brylinski--Deligne \(K_2\)-extensions yield metaplectic covers after local symbol
  pushout and split canonically over rational points in the global adelic theory.
- `[LITERATURE]` In the adelic Schrödinger model, the rational splitting is enforced by the theta
  distribution, the adelic product formula, and Poisson summation; local Maslov/Hilbert-symbol
  defects cancel globally.  Thus the splitting is arithmetic descent data, not evidence that all
  local twisting is trivial.
- `[OPEN]` No primary source identifies this lift with Deninger's desired arithmetic coefficient
  complex or proves its Xi comparison.

## Conjecture

`[CONJECTURE] [DAC_METAPLECTIC_STEINBERG_DESCENT]`:
the finite-correspondence realization of the corrected rational-Witt prime-holonomy groupoid
\(\mathcal G_{\mathbb Z}\) carries:

1. a rank-two oriented leafwise correspondence bundle \(T_{\mathrm{arith}}\) with positive
   similitude character
   \[
     \nu:\mathcal G_{\mathbb Z}\longrightarrow\mathbb R_{>0},
     \qquad \nu(F_p)=p;
   \]
2. a universal Steinberg central extension
   \[
     K_2^{\mathrm{St}}\longrightarrow
     \widetilde{\mathcal G}_{\mathbb Z}^{\mathrm{St}}
     \longrightarrow\mathcal G_{\mathbb Z},
   \]
   constructed before quotienting \(K_2^{\mathrm{St}}\) by any Hilbert-symbol character;
3. a metaplectic-similitude pushout of this extension whose centered action is
   \(\nu(g)^{-1/2}g\);
4. an adelic theta distribution invariant under the rational lift, with local factors equal to
   the prime and archimedean Weil representations and with global invariance proved by Poisson
   summation;
5. an associated complex quaternionic coefficient bundle
   \(\mathscr S_{\mathrm{arith}}\) whose local model is
   `deninger-rectangular-quaternionic-hodge`, whose transition model is

def flatTensorHolonomy (a : ℝ) : Multiplicative ℤ →*
    ((Fibre ⊗[ℝ] Fibre) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Fibre ⊗[ℝ] Fibre)) :=
  flatTensorSquareHom.comp (holonomyRepresentation a)

/-- The tensor circle holonomy retains the source holonomy on both tensor legs. -/
theorem flatTensorHolonomy_tmul (a : ℝ) (n : Multiplicative ℤ) (v w : Fibre) :
    flatTensorHolonomy a n (v ⊗ₜ[ℝ] w) =
      holonomyRepresentation a n v ⊗ₜ[ℝ] holonomyRepresentation a n w := rfl

/-- The generating tensor holonomy is precisely the previously classified one-turn transport. -/
theorem flatTensorHolonomy_generator (a : ℝ) :
    flatTensorHolonomy a (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) = flatBoostTensor a := by
  change flatTensorSquareHom (holonomyRepresentation a (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1)) = _
  rw [holonomy_generator]
  rfl

/-- Integer winding acts by powers of the classified generating tensor holonomy. -/
theorem flatTensorHolonomy_winding (a : ℝ) (n : ℤ) :
    flatTensorHolonomy a (Multiplicative.ofAdd n) = flatBoostTensor a ^ n := by
  change flatTensorSquareHom (boost a ^ n) = flatBoostTensor a ^ n
  exact map_zpow flatTensorSquareHom (boost a) n

/-- The same fixed-space classification holds for every integer winding of the actual connection. -/
theorem flatTensorHolonomy_fixed_space (a : ℝ) (x : Fibre ⊗[ℝ] Fibre) :
    (∀ n : ℤ, flatTensorHolonomy a (Multiplicative.ofAdd n) x = x) ↔ a=0 ∨
      ∃ r s : ℝ, x = r • (eMinus ⊗ₜ[ℝ] ePlus) + s • (ePlus ⊗ₜ[ℝ] eMinus) := by
  rw [← flatBoostTensor_fixed_space]
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa only [flatTensorHolonomy_generator] using h 1
  · intro h n
    rw [flatTensorHolonomy_winding]
    have hf : x ∈ MulAction.fixedBy (Fibre ⊗[ℝ] Fibre) (flatBoostTensor a) := h
    exact MulAction.mem_fixedBy_zpow hf n

/-- The constant connection one-form `-a J dφ` in its single coordinate direction. -/
def connectionForm (a : ℝ) : Fin 1 → Module.End ℝ Fibre :=
  fun _ => -a • boostGenerator

/-- Coordinate curvature of a constant connection one-form.  Derivative terms vanish, leaving
the commutator of its two coordinate components. -/
def constantConnectionCurvature (a : ℝ) (i j : Fin 1) : Module.End ℝ Fibre :=
  (connectionForm a i).comp (connectionForm a j) -
    (connectionForm a j).comp (connectionForm a i)

/-- The connection `d-aJ dφ` is flat: every curvature component is zero. -/
theorem connection_flat (a : ℝ) :
    ∀ i j, constantConnectionCurvature a i j = 0 := by
  intro i j
  have hij : i = j := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst j
  simp [constantConnectionCurvature]

/-- Parallel transport path from the identity to one turn of the connection. -/
noncomputable def parallelTransportPath (a : ℝ) (v : Fibre) (t : ℝ) : Fibre :=
  boost (a * t) v

/-- Scalar derivative predicate with the canonical normed-algebra module structure on `ℝ`. -/
abbrev ScalarHasDerivAt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (f' x : ℝ) : Prop :=
  @HasDerivAt ℝ _ ℝ _ (NormedAlgebra.toNormedSpace ℝ).toModule _ _ f f' x

/-- The two boost coordinates solve the parallel equation `v̇=aJv` of `d-aJ dφ`. -/
theorem parallelTransportPath_satisfies_equation (a : ℝ) (v : Fibre) (t : ℝ) :
    ScalarHasDerivAt (fun x => (parallelTransportPath a v x).1)
        (a * (parallelTransportPath a v t).2) t ∧
      ScalarHasDerivAt (fun x => (parallelTransportPath a v x).2)
        (a * (parallelTransportPath a v t).1) t := by
  have harg : ScalarHasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => a * x) a t := by
    simpa only [id_eq, mul_one] using (hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul a
  have hcosh : ScalarHasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.cosh (a * x))
      (a * Real.sinh (a * t)) t := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_def, id_eq, mul_one, mul_comm] using
      (Real.hasDerivAt_cosh (a * t)).comp t harg
  have hsinh : ScalarHasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.sinh (a * x))
      (a * Real.cosh (a * t)) t := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_def, id_eq, mul_one, mul_comm] using
      (Real.hasDerivAt_sinh (a * t)).comp t harg
  have hfirst := (hcosh.mul_const v.1).add (hsinh.mul_const v.2)
  have hsecond := (hsinh.mul_const v.1).add (hcosh.mul_const v.2)
  constructor
  · convert hfirst using 1
    · funext x
      simp only [parallelTransportPath, boost_apply, Pi.add_apply]
    · simp only [parallelTransportPath, boost_apply]
      ring
  · convert hsecond using 1
    · funext x
      simp only [parallelTransportPath, boost_apply, Pi.add_apply]
    · simp only [parallelTransportPath, boost_apply]
      ring

/-- One full positive turn ends at the boost `g_a`. -/
theorem parallelTransportPath_one (a : ℝ) (v : Fibre) :
    parallelTransportPath a v 1 = boost a v := by
  simp [parallelTransportPath]

/-- Monodromy representation of the circle fundamental group, generated by `g_a`. -/
noncomputable def holonomyRepresentation (a : ℝ) :
    Multiplicative ℤ →* (Fibre ≃ₗ[ℝ] Fibre) :=
  zpowersHom (Fibre ≃ₗ[ℝ] Fibre) (boost a)

/-- Positive generator has holonomy `g_a`. -/
@[simp]
theorem holonomy_generator (a : ℝ) :
    holonomyRepresentation a (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1) = boost a := by
  simp [holonomyRepresentation]

/-- Global holonomy is exactly the cyclic subgroup generated by `g_a`. -/
theorem holonomy_range_eq_zpowers (a : ℝ) :
    Set.range (holonomyRepresentation a) = Subgroup.zpowers (boost a) := by
  change ((holonomyRepresentation a).range : Set (Fibre ≃ₗ[ℝ] Fibre)) = _
  rw [holonomyRepresentation, Subgroup.range_zpowersHom]

/-- Initial Cartan involution `θ₀=B`. -/
def initialCartan : Module.End ℝ Fibre where
  toFun v := (v.1, -v.2)
  map_add' _ _ := by ext <;> simp [add_comm]
  map_smul' _ _ := by ext <;> simp

@[simp]
theorem initialCartan_apply (v : Fibre) : initialCartan v = (v.1, -v.2) :=
  rfl

/-- Cartan polarization `θ_u=g_u θ₀ g_u⁻¹`. -/
noncomputable def cartan (u : ℝ) : Module.End ℝ Fibre :=
  (boost u).toLinearMap.comp
    (initialCartan.comp (boost (-u)).toLinearMap)

@[simp]
theorem cartan_apply (u : ℝ) (v : Fibre) :
    cartan u v = boost u (initialCartan (boost (-u) v)) :=
  rfl

theorem cartan_apply_formula (u : ℝ) (v : Fibre) :

  rw [Real.cosh_two_mul, Real.sinh_two_mul]
